scope: Unadopted scalp-following tapered hair clumps. Complete-head quality and production adoption remain open.

findings: Surface-tangent normals replace offsets from the world origin. Short/swept clumps follow the scalp; cross-sections taper to closed root/tip points and follow the curved path.
Loose long hair uses thicker flattened clumps and a skull-side path rather than a sparse curtain across the face. Locs retain a distinct falling form.

An outward-normal check exposed a near-crown path fold. Continued scalp travel, a stable root reference and curvature-bounded thickness repair the sampled fold. Center samples are memoized during construction.

Front/three-quarter/profile saved-person comparisons and ordinary96x120 controlled galleries show the selected changes. Broad cap silhouette, sparse locs/long-hair ends, patterned gray contrast, painted beard, rigid mouth and mannequin-like anatomy remain craft defects.
inspection.qualification: Controlled raw DTO style/texture comparisons do not prove all combinations are generator-eligible. No empirical grooming frequencies, measured hair coefficients, production performance, watertight manifold or all-device proof.
